topic: What beamforming strategies ensure consistent LOS connectivity for A2A links in dynamically changing flight formations?
consensus_response: To maintain consistent Line-of-Sight (LOS) connectivity for A2A links in dynamically changing flight formations, dynamic beamforming strategies are essential. Phased Array Antennas (PAA) can offer real-time beam steering and shaping capabilities, reducing the need for complex ML algorithms. Integrating PAA with adaptive nulling can mitigate interference among aircraft, improving overall connectivity. Additionally, exploiting global time references provided by GPS for synchronization among network nodes can help in scheduling contention-free transmissions and improving overall connectivity.
reference_context: A2A communication systems involve rapidly fluctuating frequency selective fading due to high aircraft velocities, particularly when two aircraft are flying in opposite directions, resulting in Rician distributed fading. The LOS path is dominant, and maintaining reliable connectivity is fundamental for AANETs to achieve data delivery.
